notes.subject: כרה
notes.rationale: 'dig' — many read here as 'prepare a feast/banquet' (from digging a pit for a feast); literal 'dig a hole over him' kept

notes.subject: ol man bilong salim ol kago
notes.rationale: כנענים literally 'Canaanites', idiomatically 'merchants/traders'; both kept fused

notes.subject: Yahwe i tokim Ayub
notes.rationale: Rhetorical question continuing the address to Job

translation: Ol wantok bilong wok wantaim i ken karim hol long em na ol ken skruim ⟨את⟩ em namel long ol man bilong salim ol kago bilong Kenan?
